title: Specified integral finite scalar model interfaces
statement: For commutative condensed coefficient rings and schemes, define the point module category, exact point pullback, pulled-back mono-cokernel complex and augmentation, geometric and scalar adjunctions, coefficient mate gamma, derived restriction, its conjugate pushforward comparison, and scalar-first projection. Define the normalized augmentation condition, point-composition comparison, DerivedAssertions and PerfectModel by exactly the formulas of the original integral finite scalar model interface. These are unchanged definitions moved to a dependency module, so the resolution and comparison statements can be stated separately without import cycles.
